result.stateSummary: THE OWNER DECISION QUEUE is the estate's single consolidated surface for owner decisions, opened 2026-07-26 by owner order and grown by append into 125 numbered sections spanning 2026-07-26 to 2026-08-15. Resolutions are recorded in place as "✅ RULED <date>: …" and never deleted, so a section without such a line — or one whose ruling only schedules the act ("waits on", "parked", "docketed", "owed", "stays open") — is still open. Its character changes across the file: §§0–9 are a compact decision register (T/D/G/P/M/EP rows), while §§10–125 become a running chair ledger of train rulings in which most "rulings" are dispositions that mint new deferrals — micro-acts, dockets, re-charters and compile obligations — faster than they discharge them. Four superseding owner grants (§17, §22, §24, §37) release nearly every permission-class blocker, but four carve-outs survive by nature and still gate the tail: external legal/counsel, the V5 aesthetic cull, THE TUNING SIGNATURE, and each push/deploy; §53.1's P1 records that even the grants' reach over the signature and pushes is itself an unanswered owner question. Of the ~78 items enumerated here, roughly a dozen are strictly owner acts (the launch tail T1–T15, the §13 worktree, the §67.6 cull, §66.4 import-vs-restore, the M44 dial list, the two tm value flags), about twenty are chartered-but-unbuilt programs (the whole LG logistics family, tm, AO/H26, gen-2, the ~96 remaining family waves, the §109 total review), and the rest are docketed engineering debts and micro-acts queued behind an executor order that the record ends mid-flight.
